description: Hi, we’re CosmicPhantoms. We’re a small team working remotely on the Martian Map challenge. We both love space, and Mars especially, and we like making science feel less intimidating and more fun to explore. We’re just getting started, so your ideas can shape where this goes. We’re looking for people into data analysis, data visualization, planetary science or UI design, but curious beginners are welcome. We’ll keep things friendly, talk often and share the work fairly. Come build with us.
